newsitem.title: POLAND: Carrefour builds hypermarket in Warsaw.
newsitem.headline: Carrefour builds hypermarket in Warsaw.

text.p: French retailer Carrefour on Tuesday began the construction of its first Polish hypermarket, which will cost $43 million, PAP news agency reported.

The agency said that the hypermarket, employing 500 people, would be located in Warsaw's eastern district of Praga and have an area of 35,000 square metres. Half of the shopping area would be rented to other retailers.
PAP said Carrefour was building the hypermarket in partnership with two Danish companies and the Danish government's Fund for Central and Eastern Europe.
After Casino, Auchan and Leclerc, Carrefour would be the fourth French retailer to launch a supermarket in Poland.
